ipos.name: Core4 Engineers
ipos.about: Core4 Engineers is an engineering, procurement, and construction company providing solutions across the power distribution, water and wastewater, automation, and utility infrastructure sectors. The company’s core business activities involve executing projects that include railway electrification, civil works, high-tension and low-tension electrical systems, and the design, supply, testing, and commissioning of water and wastewater treatment plants. It is also engaged in power transmission and distribution projects, as well as the supply of electrical panels, compact substations, and SCADA automation systems. Revenue is primarily generated through milestone-based billing on these contracts, which are executed for private-sector clients, government agencies, and public sector undertakings. The company operates a manufacturing facility and frequently executes specialized projects through joint ventures and sub-contracting arrangements, with a significant geographic concentration of its current operations located in Karnataka.
strengths: Proven track record in power and water EPC projects.
Strong expertise in complex railway electrification works.
Strategic expansion into high-growth water treatment contracts.
In-house electrical panel manufacturing ensures seamless integration.
Led by a highly experienced promoter and management team.
risks: Over 95% revenue concentration in Karnataka poses regional risks.
High financial reliance on a limited number of key customers.
Overdependence on the water and wastewater treatment segment.
Reliance on third-party subcontractors creates execution risks.
High working capital requirements may strain liquidity and cash flows.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for new manufacturing facility and corporate office (4.12 (7.52%))

ipos.name: EAAA India Alternatives
ipos.about: EAAA India Alternatives is a prominent alternative asset management platform operating across multiple jurisdictions and regulated by various authorities, including SEBI. The enterprise primarily functions as an investment manager for alternative investment funds and portfolio management services. Its core business activities are divided into two primary operating segments: Private Credit and Real Assets. The Private Credit vertical encompasses performing credit, investment-grade credit, special situations, and real estate credit. The Real Assets segment focuses on infrastructure yield and commercial real estate yield investments. The entity generates its revenue primarily through management and advisory fees charged on the capital committed or invested across its active funds, co-investment vehicles, and infrastructure investment trusts. Additionally, it earns general partner income from its own investments in the managed funds and variable additional returns based on the performance of the underlying investments upon exceeding specified hurdle rates.
strengths: Stable management fees from long-term, multi-year contracts.
Strong three-year FPAUM CAGR of 23.43% from Fiscal 2023 to 2026.
Well-diversified footprint of real asset investments across India.
Strong employee retention via performance-based rewards.
Healthy asset-liability mismatch position for effective management.
risks: Unpredictable variable returns contribute to cash flow volatility.
Lack of listed peers complicates valuation and investor perception.
Unfulfilled capital calls by clients restrict investments.
Fund underperformance could reduce revenue and impede capital-raising.
High capital concentration exposes funds to localized shifts.

ipos.name: SFC Environmental Technologies
ipos.about: SFC Environmental Technologies provides environmental technologies and engineering solutions across three primary segments: wastewater treatment, wastewater recycling and reuse, and solid waste treatment. In the wastewater treatment segment, the company offers the C-Tech sequencing batch reactor technology. For wastewater recycling and reuse, it provides ultrafiltration, closed-circuit reverse osmosis, and membrane bioreactor technologies. The solid waste treatment segment utilizes OREX technology to extract organic materials from mixed waste, with the company currently operating two municipal solid waste treatment plants in Goa. The company generates revenue by providing these technologies and solutions to private engineering, procurement, and construction companies, as well as directly to government entities and municipalities. Additionally, the company manufactures essential components such as decanters, diffusers, blowers, programmable logic controllers, and hollow fibre membranes at its facilities located in Maharashtra and the Czech Republic to support its environmental treatment projects.
strengths: Established solid waste management operations in Goa.
Strong order book driving repeat business.
Strategic biogas and waste-to-energy partnerships.
In-house manufacturing of essential treatment components.
Comprehensive wastewater and solid waste solutions.
risks: Revenues heavily dependent on government entities.
High reliance on top 10 customers.
Significant and seasonal working capital requirements.
Pending legal proceedings against company subsidiaries.
Reliance on limited third-party material suppliers.

ipos.name: BLS Polymers
ipos.about: BLS Polymers manufactures custom-formulated polymer compounds utilized for sheathing, jacketing, and insulation of wires and cables across the telecommunications, power, and railway industries, alongside protective coatings for underground oil, gas, and water pipelines. The company generates revenue through core manufacturing operations and trading activities involving primary raw materials. Its principal product portfolio encompasses various grades of wire and cable compounds, high-density polyethylene, linear low-density polyethylene resins, polyethylene pipe coatings, and adhesives for three-layer polyethylene applications. Operating from a single manufacturing facility located in Goa, BLS Polymers caters to domestic clients while also exporting to international markets, including Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh. The company’s products are enlisted with prominent government agencies, public sector enterprises, and the Government of Gujarat, serving critical infrastructure sectors and addressing specific, precise requirements in terms of high quality, composition, and tolerances.
strengths: Approved supplier for major government agencies and CPSEs.
Diverse products for telecom, power, railway, oil, and gas.
High repeat order rate from an established customer base.
In-house product development and testing labs ensure quality.
Growing presence in specialized 3LPE pipeline adhesives.
risks: Heavily dependent on wire and cable compound sales.
Top 10 customers drive a major share of total revenue.
Highly exposed to operational risks at its single Goa plant.
Lacks long-term supply contracts for primary raw materials.
High working capital needs tied up in trade receivables.
objectsOfIssue: Financing capital expenditure for expanding manufacturing facility capacity (77.56 (30.42%))

ipos.name: Wiscon Industries
ipos.about: Wiscon Industries is a Delhi-based company primarily engaged in the trading and distribution of a comprehensive range of consumer electronic products. The company’s core product portfolio includes LED televisions, air coolers, washing machines, and air conditioners, which are marketed and supplied under its flagship brand, Wiscon. In addition to its proprietary brand offerings, the company generates revenue by selling electric scooters under a third-party brand. Wiscon Industries operates a flexible warehouse-based logistics model to supply its products to both business-to-business and business-to-consumer customers across India. While the company largely procures its electronic products from domestic third-party manufacturers, it has recently acquired Dalmia Technologies, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. This subsidiary serves as a specialized original equipment manufacturer dedicated to the production of LED televisions, supporting both the company’s internal supply requirements and external independent traders in the market.
strengths: Diverse product portfolio: LED TVs, coolers, washing machines, and ACs.
Dedicated LED TV OEM subsidiary, Dalmia Technologies.
Flexible and efficient warehouse-based distribution model.
Holds ISO 9001:2015 and Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) certifications.
Cost-effective and strategic domestic product sourcing.
risks: Top 10 suppliers account for 99.77% of recent purchases.
Top 10 customers drive 63.36% of recent revenues.
Sales are heavily concentrated in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Haryana.
LED TVs and electric scooters generate 92.66% of total revenues.
The company reported negative cash flows and a net loss in fiscal 2024
objectsOfIssue: Investment in WOS for capital expenditure towards plant and machinery (15.04 (17.09%))
Investment in WOS for funding its incremental working capital requirements (35 (39.77%))
To meet working capital requirements of the company (17 (19.32%))
To fund marketing and promotional activities (5.23 (5.94%))

ipos.name: M.K.Sons Fine Jewels
ipos.about: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels operates in the gems and jewellery sector, retailing a diverse portfolio of over 19,442 stock-keeping units that includes gold, diamond-studded, coloured stone, platinum, and silver jewellery. The company generates all revenue through direct sales from a retail network of five physical showrooms across Gujarat and Maharashtra. While it does not manufacture products internally, the business relies on an in-house design team to conceptualize new collections, alongside procuring finished articles from external suppliers. Third-party manufacturers and skilled karigars execute production and customization under job-work arrangements. Formed after acquiring the proprietary business of M. K. Sons Jewellers in 2025, the company caters directly to retail customers. To enhance the buying experience, it maintains an exclusive experience lounge tailored for showcasing premium, high-end jewellery to discerning clients.
strengths: Established physical retail footprint with an exclusive experience lounge.
Diverse portfolio of over 19,442 gold, diamond, and platinum SKUs.
Strategic operational focus on high-demand western Indian markets.
Dedicated in-house design team for trend-focused, customizable collections.
Expanding store network driven by strategic inventory deployment.
risks: Revenue generation is heavily concentrated in Gujarat showrooms.
Entirely reliant on third-party manufacturers without long-term contracts.
Profitability is vulnerable to gold and diamond price volatility.
Historical track record of negative operating net cash flows.
High working capital requirements to maintain optimal showroom inventory.
objectsOfIssue: New Maharashtra showroom and Gujarat showroom expansion inventory (152.84 (55.50%))
Repay or pre-pay certain borrowings availed by the Company (30 (10.89%))

ipos.name: Carver Roboweld
ipos.about: Carver Roboweld is a manufacturer of welding consumables, specifically focusing on welding rods, metal-cored wires, and gouging electrodes, while also supplying various welding spare parts and accessories. The enterprise operates a dedicated manufacturing facility situated in Bamanbore, Rajkot, Gujarat, where it produces its core consumable products. Alongside manufacturing, the business manages three service units located in Pune, Ludhiana, and Hosur. These units support the deployment of its robotic welding systems, welding automation solutions, repair and maintenance services, and overall customer support activities. The entity also provides specialized forging die manufacturing and regeneration services, along with welding robot rental services that utilize specialized operating software. Notably, the business derives its entire revenue from operations exclusively from customers operating within the forging industry. By integrating consumable production with automated robotic deployment, the organization caters directly to the operational and maintenance requirements of its forging sector clientele.
strengths: Exclusive client base within the forging industry.
Three distributed service units ensure efficient robotic support.
Integrated model combining consumables and robot rentals.
Consistent historical revenue growth and profitability.
Dedicated Gujarat facility for consumable production.
risks: Revenues rely entirely on forging industry demand.
Top ten clients generate over 80% of revenue.
High reliance on a few suppliers for raw materials.
Potential cost overruns from delays in robot procurement.
History of delays in statutory dues and filings.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure requirements towards the purchase of welding robots (11.99 (42.38%))
Repay or pre-pay certain borrowings availed by the Company (8.60 (30.40%))

ipos.name: Bombay Coated & Special Steels
ipos.about: Bombay Coated and Special Steels operates a multi-location steel processing centre that caters to the customised requirements of original equipment manufacturers and original design manufacturers. The company primarily procures coated steel coils, such as galvalume, colour-coated, and galvanized, alongside non-coated cold-rolled and hot-rolled steel coils. As an authorised service partner for JSW Steel Coated Products, the company sources most of its raw materials through this arrangement. Using high-precision engineering machinery across its four manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Andhra Pradesh, it processes these coils into value-added products. These include slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks, and sheared blanks, manufactured through specialized slitting, cut-to-length, shearing, and embossing lines. The company generates the majority of its revenue by supplying these processed steel products to the home and commercial appliances sector, while also serving the general engineering, automotive, and electrical equipment industries.
strengths: Authorised service partner of JSWSCPL, ensuring reliable raw material supply.
Strategically located facilities providing efficient logistics and delivery.
High-precision manufacturing setup meeting strict customer specifications.
Long-standing relationships with leading OEM and ODM customers.
Diverse value-added processing capabilities across multiple locations.
risks: High debt-to-equity ratio restricts financial flexibility through stringent covenants.
Substantial reliance on JSWSCPL for sourcing the primary raw material.
Significant revenue concentration among the top ten key customers.
Susceptibility to price volatility and disruptions in steel coil supply.
Strong dependence on the cyclical home and commercial appliances sector.
objectsOfIssue: Repayment or pre-payment of certain borrowings (125 (68.28%))
Financing capital equipment acquisition under lease (15.77 (8.61%))

ipos.name: Acko
ipos.about: Acko is a Bengaluru-based digital-first insurance company founded in 2016 by Varun Dua. It operates as a direct-to-consumer insurer offering motor, health, travel, and other insurance products through a fully online platform, bypassing traditional agents. The company has positioned itself as a technology-led insurtech player with a strong focus on simplifying policy purchase and claims experience. Backed by investors such as General Atlantic, Accel, and CPP Investments, Acko has raised over $580 million to date and has built scale through embedded distribution partnerships and digital channels.

ipos.name: OYO
ipos.about: Oravel Stays Limited operates a global asset-light hospitality platform connecting property owners with short-stay guests via branding, tech tools, and operational support. It operates across three core verticals: Hotels (OYO, Sunday, Townhouse, Motel 6, Studio 6), Homes (Belvilla, DanCenter, Checkmyguest), and Listings (European subscription services). Additional offerings include wedding venues, co-working spaces, tours, food and beverage, and insurance facilitation. Revenue stems from partner revenue-sharing, home booking commissions, listing subscriptions, and G6 franchisee royalties.As Oyo’s parent prepares for its third IPO attempt under the “PRISM” brand, its evolution from a budget hotel chain into a global distribution platform has driven cash-positive operations. However, a lingering ₹3,000 crore debt load and shrinking direct demand pose ongoing challenges to its growth ambitions. Readmore
strengths: Asset-light business model enables expansion with limited ownership of hotel properties.
Diversified hospitality portfolio spans hotels, vacation homes, and property listing businesses.
Technology platform supports pricing, distribution, partner operations, and customer experience.
Presence across multiple countries reduces dependence on a single market.
Revenue comes from multiple streams, including revenue sharing, commissions, subscriptions, and franchise royalties.
risks: The company has incurred losses in the past and may not sustain profitability in the future.
A significant portion of the IPO proceeds will be used to repay borrowings of its subsidiary.
The business depends on maintaining relationships with hotel owners, property partners, and franchisees.
Any technology failure, cyberattack, or data security breach could disrupt operations and affect the business.
The company is involved in legal and regulatory proceedings that could adversely affect its business, financial condition, and reputation.
objectsOfIssue: Investment in subsidiary Oravel Stays Singapore Pte. Ltd. to repay or prepay its borrowings (4987.50 (75%))

ipos.name: Parle Products
ipos.about: Parle Products is one of India’s largest and oldest fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) companies, founded in 1929 by the Chauhan family in Mumbai. It is best known for its flagship brand Parle-G, widely regarded as the world’s top-selling biscuit. Over decades, the company has built a diversified portfolio including brands such as Monaco, KrackJack, Hide & Seek, Melody, and Mango Bite. With a strong rural and urban distribution network and presence across multiple price segments, Parle remains a dominant player in India’s biscuit and confectionery market.

ipos.name: MakeMyTrip
ipos.about: MakeMyTrip Limited is India’s leading online travel platform, offering services across flights, hotels, holiday packages, rail, bus, and cab bookings through its brands—MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, and redBus. The company is listed on Nasdaq and operates primarily through its Indian subsidiaries, catering to both retail and corporate travel segments. Over the years, it has built a dominant position in India’s online travel market, supported by a wide inventory, strong brand recall, and increasing adoption of digital travel services.

ipos.name: BOAT
ipos.about: Imagine Marketing Limited was incorporated in November 2013 and operates primarily under the brand“boAt”, launched in 2015. The company was founded and is promoted by Sameer Ashok Mehta, Aman Gupta, and South Lake Investment Ltd. It is a digital-first consumer electronics company focused on lifestyle-oriented, mass-premium products at accessible price points.The company designs, markets, and sells a wide range of consumer devices, including personal and large audio products, wearables such as smartwatches and smart rings, and charging solutions like cables, chargers, and power banks. Operations are asset-light, with manufacturing largely outsourced to strategic partners, while the company focuses on product design, branding, marketing, and distribution.
strengths: Strong brand recall among young, digitally native consumers.
Asset-light, digital-first business model with scalable operations.
Diversified product portfolio across audio, wearables, and accessories.
Omni-channel distribution with strong online and growing offline presence.
Data-driven product design and marketing capabilities.
risks: High dependence on third-party manufacturers and suppliers.
Intense competition in the consumer electronics and wearables market.
Profitability sensitive to marketing spend and working capital needs.
Exposure to rapid changes in consumer preferences and technology.
Significant reliance on online sales platforms for revenue.

ipos.name: Zepto
ipos.about: Zepto Limited operates a quick commerce platform that enables users to purchase a wide range of products from third-party merchant partners through the “Zepto” mobile application. Orders placed on the platform are processed through strategically located dark stores operated by the company and delivered to users through last-mile delivery partners. In addition to groceries and household products, merchant partners offer freshly prepared food items through Zepto Café, which uses the same dark store and delivery infrastructure. The company also provides advertising and promotional solutions to brand partners, including sponsored placements, in-app advertising, analytics and campaign performance tools, creating an additional monetisation channel. Further, it offers supply chain services by sourcing products from brands and selling them to wholesalers and retailers on a non-exclusive basis. The company’s business is supported by its in-house technology systems that help manage operations, fulfilment, delivery and user engagement.
strengths: Fastest-growing quick commerce platform in India by order volume among scaled players between Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2026.
Significant increase in market share of quick commerce orders, rising from about 26% to 35% during the period.
Operates a technology-driven quick commerce model supported by dark stores and optimised delivery networks.
Generates revenue from multiple streams including product sales, advertising solutions, Zepto Café, and supply chain services.
Uses in-house technology systems to manage operations, fulfilment, delivery, and user engagement.
risks: The company has incurred losses in recent years and may not achieve or sustain profitability in the future.
Intense competition in the quick commerce sector could affect growth, market share, and profitability.
Negative publicity, including social media commentary, could harm the company’s reputation and business.
Failure to ensure product quality, quantity, or accuracy could lead to recalls, refunds, and reputational damage.
Food safety, hygiene, and quality issues related to Zepto Café could adversely impact operations and brand image.
objectsOfIssue: Lease payments for existing dark stores (1734.94 (21.66%))
Invest in technology and cloud infrastructure (1324.78 (16.54%))
Inorganic growth opportunities and general corporate purposes (2801.30 (34.97%))

ipos.name: PhonePe
ipos.about: Incorporated in 2015, PhonePe is a leading digital payments and financial services company owned by Walmart. It enables users to perform various financial transactions, including sending and receiving money, recharging mobile phones and DTH services, making utility payments, and conducting in-store transactions. It was India’s first Unified Payments Interface (UPI)-based payments app launched by a non-bank fintech company.
strengths: Leading digital payments platform with a large and active user base
Strong brand recall supported by the PhonePe app ecosystem
Diversified offerings across UPI, wallets, insurance, wealth, and merchant services
Deep integration with merchants and financial institutions across India
Backed by experienced promoters and strong technology capabilities
risks: Continued losses and negative cash flows may persist in the near term
Highly competitive fintech and digital payments market
Heavy dependence on UPI transaction volumes and regulatory framework
Data security and technology failures could impact trust and operations
Regulatory changes may affect business model and monetization

ipos.name: Cult.fit
ipos.about: Cult.Fit Limited is a fitness and wellness company that operates an integrated platform offering fitness services and fitness products through both online and offline channels. The company generates revenue primarily from fitness memberships, partner- and franchise-operated fitness centres, and the sale of fitness products through its digital platform and retail network. Its fitness services include company-owned centres, franchise and marketplace gyms, along with technology-enabled offerings delivered through the Cult.fit app. The company also sells active lifestyle and fitness-related products across multiple categories. Cult.Fit follows an asset-light expansion strategy by franchising fitness centres through its “gym-in-a-box” model, which supports partners with centre design, equipment, and operational processes. Its technology platform integrates fitness services and products, enabling cross-selling, customer engagement, class management, and operational efficiency across its network.
strengths: Category creator and leader in India’s fitness services market with a focus on accessibility and innovation.
An asset-light franchise model supports the scalable expansion of fitness centres.
Technology platform improves customer experience and operational efficiency.
Strong Cult.fit brand with omnichannel distribution across fitness services and products.
Integrated business creates synergies between fitness services and fitness products.
risks: The business depends on continued demand for fitness services and fitness products in India.
The business is seasonal, so quarterly performance may not reflect full-year results.
Delays or cost overruns in planned expansion could affect business performance and results.
Any change in the planned use of IPO proceeds requires shareholder approval and regulatory compliance.
The company’s financial statements are prepared under Ind AS, which differs from IFRS and U.S. GAAP
objectsOfIssue: Lease, rent and licence payments for existing fitness centres (217.5 (22.90%))
Brand marketing, advertising and business promotion (75 (7.90%))
Invest in Cultsport Private Limited to set up new Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs) (23.4 (2.50%))

ipos.name: KUKU (Mebigo Labs)
ipos.about: Kuku, operated by parent company Mebigo Labs, is an Indian audio content platform (earlier branded as Kuku FM) focused on audiobooks, stories, and knowledge content in multiple Indian languages. Positioned as a vernacular audio OTT “soonicorn”, it targets the fast‑growing regional‑language user base across Tier‑2 and Tier‑3 cities, building a large subscription‑driven and freemium audience. The company has raised venture funding over the years, and by mid‑2025, its private‑market valuation was reported to be around 500 million dollars, reflecting strong traction and revenue growth, though this is distinct from any eventual IPO pricing.

ipos.name: Tata Sons
ipos.about: Tata Sons Private Limited is the principal investment holding company and promoter of the Tata Group, India’s largest conglomerate, founded over 155 years ago. It sits at the top of a distinctive governance structure combining philanthropic ownership with strategic control across sectors like IT, automotive, materials, aerospace, retail, and hospitality.

ipos.name: Upstox
ipos.about: Upstox is one of India’s leading online trading platforms, backed by prominent investors including Tiger Global Management, Stride Ventures, and the late Ratan Tata. The company achieved unicorn status in 2021 following a funding round that valued it at $3.5 billion. Upstox has raised approximately $220 million across 6 funding rounds to date.

ipos.name: Inox Clean Energy
ipos.about: Inox Clean Energy operates in independent power production (renewables; 2,375.05 MW capacity under long-term PPAs with utilities and hyperscalers) and solar module manufacturing (Bavla, Gujarat facility, with Dhenkanal, Odisha cells under development). Backed by group entities for project execution, the company is expanding globally, including the United States and Africa, through acquisitions and joint ventures. Readmore
strengths: 2,375.05 MW operational capacity across wind, solar, and hybrid projects.
High revenue visibility with 19.10 years’ average remaining PPA tenure.
Expanding global footprint with projects across Africa and the United States.
Integrated project execution backed by the INOXGFL Group’s infrastructure.
Strong 70% capacity utilization achieved at the Phase 1 Bavla solar facility
risks: Limited operating history in solar generation and large-scale manufacturing.
High revenue concentration with top off-takers driving over 82% of sales.
Heavy reliance on the INOXGFL Group for project execution and components.
Lack of long-term raw material supply agreements exposes it to price volatility.
History of negative cash flows from operating and investing activities.

ipos.name: Jio Platforms
ipos.about: ﻿﻿
strengths: Operates a full-stack technology platform built on proprietary digital technology and connectivity infrastructure.
Has the largest spectrum holding in India; has the most extensive network infrastructure with nationwide wireless and broadband coverage.
Net debt to EBITDA has fallen from 0.88x (FY24) to 0.36x (FY26)
Carried about 60% of India’s wireless data traffic in FY26
Capitalizes on the distribution strength of Reliance Retail and the MyJio App to distribute connections and digital services

Changes in telecom licensing, spectrum policies, or data regulations could affect business operations.
Cybersecurity threats, data privacy issues, or infrastructure vulnerabilities could impact customer trust and services.
₹1.05 lakh crore owed to DoT in deferred spectrum payments
Has never paid a dividend; RIL keeps control after listing
objectsOfIssue: Repayment or prepayment of certain Company borrowings (27500 (91.10%))

ipos.name: Paras Healthcare
ipos.about: Paras Healthcare operates a network of multi-specialty tertiary care hospitals under the “Paras Health” brand, primarily focused on the healthcare markets of North India and East India. The company’s core business involves providing advanced healthcare services, including complex quaternary care and specialized therapeutic treatments. It manages eight operational hospitals across cities such as Gurugram, Patna, Panchkula, Ranchi, Udaipur, Srinagar, Darbhanga, and Kanpur, with a total bed capacity of 2,211 beds as of June 30, 2026. Paras Healthcare generates the majority of its revenue from in-patient department services, which include consultations, surgeries, and specialized treatments. The company’s revenue is heavily driven by six core clinical specialties: cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastro sciences, orthopedics and sports injury, and renal sciences. Additionally, the company generates a smaller portion of its income through in-house pharmacy sales and outpatient consultations.
strengths: Established “Paras Health” brand in underserved North and East India markets.
High revenue reliance on specialized CONGOR clinical programs.
Diversified network of eight multi-specialty hospitals with 2,211 beds.
Advanced quaternary care supported by modern medical infrastructure.
Improved occupancy rates and a turnaround to profitability in Fiscal 2026.
risks: High medical staff attrition may impact care quality.
High revenue concentration in North India poses regional risks.
Over-reliance on CONGOR specialties risks revenue drops.
High debt of ₹9,394.67 million strains cash flows.
Unregistered hospital leases risk eviction and disruption.

ipos.name: Zetwerk
ipos.about: Founded in 2017, Zetwerk is a Bengaluru-based, technology-led platform that aggregates manufacturing capacity. Its software, Zetwerk OS, splits customer orders across 6,979 suppliers in 26 countries, alongside 26 of its own facilities. Products range from solar and wind components and power transformers to laptops, circuit boards, and heavy industrial equipment, for customers like Siemens Gamesa, Acer, NTPC, and DRDO.
strengths: Asset-light model: about 80% of FY26 revenue came from products made by third-party suppliers.
Zetwerk’s flexible capacity helps it deliver faster, without any large capital commitments.
Strong order pipeline: a ₹13,062 crore manufacturing order book (June 30, 2026), about 1.4x FY26 manufacturing revenue.
Repeat business: 80% of FY26 manufacturing revenue came from existing customers.
Blue-chip customers: 16 of the Nifty 50 companies and 102 of India’s Fortune 500.
Diversified: spans energy (69% of manufacturing revenue), capital goods (16%) and precision electronics (15%).
risks: Still loss-making: losses in every period shown, and negative operating cash flow every year.
Supplier dependence: quality, capacity, or supply problems at third-party suppliers would directly hit deliveries.
Customer concentration: the top 10 customers’ share of revenue rose from 22% in FY24 to 36% in FY26.
Exposed to geopolitical and tariff risks in global markets.
Pending legal proceedings could lead to adverse outcomes.
objectsOfIssue: Repayment/prepayment of borrowings availed by the company (1300 (45.94%))
Repayment/prepayment of certain borrowings availed by subsidiaries (860 (30.39%))
Funding strategic acquisitions and general corporate purposes. (670 (23.67%))

ipos.name: Tonbo Imaging India
ipos.about: Tonbo Imaging India operates as a global defence electronics original equipment manufacturer, designing and developing advanced imaging, processing, and communication systems tailored for surveillance, reconnaissance, targeting, and control. The company’s core business involves creating full-stack electro-optics systems, ranging from core sensor technology to fully integrated autonomous platforms for battlefield applications across land, air, and sea. Revenue is primarily generated through two main operating segments: tactical systems and platform systems. Tactical offerings include lightweight, weapon-mounted, and helmet-mounted electro-optical sights that provide soldiers with observation and targeting capabilities. Platform-grade optronics feature multi-sensor gimbals and infrared payloads designed for integration into armoured vehicles, airborne platforms, and naval assets. The business supplies these highly specialized combat and situational awareness systems to global militaries, homeland security agencies, and system integrators across multiple international markets through a tender-based competitive bidding and procurement model.
strengths: Owns extensive unrestricted IP in infrared imaging and target tracking.
Offers full-stack capabilities from core sensors to autonomous platforms.
Established global footprint across 24 countries with defence clients.
Led by an experienced team with 21+ years in optical defence tech.
Agile design framework enables rapid re-engineering for key components.
risks: Vulnerable to long, unpredictable government budget and tender cycles.
Dependent on a limited global supply chain for raw materials like Germanium.
Highly dependent on short-term, non-recurring tenders from selected clients.
Uses an outsourced manufacturing model, risking third-party quality or delays.
Extended gestation cycles strain liquidity and drive high working capital needs.

ipos.name: Sahajanand Medical Technologies
ipos.about: Sahajanand Medical Technologies develops, manufactures, and markets cardiovascular devices globally. The core business is divided into two primary segments: vascular intervention products, such as coronary stents and balloon catheters, and structural heart devices, including transcatheter aortic valves and occluders. The company generates the majority of its revenue from the sale of vascular intervention devices, with the Supraflex Cruz, a biodegradable polymer-based drug-eluting stent, acting as a major contributor to its sales. Products are distributed across India, Europe, and the rest of the world through a combination of direct, hybrid, and distributor-led models, supported by an extensive network of domestic and international distributors. Operations are backed by manufacturing facilities located in Surat, Hyderabad, and Thailand. Additionally, the business relies heavily on dedicated research and development capabilities to continually enhance existing products and introduce new cardiovascular treatments.
strengths: Strong portfolio of vascular and structural heart medical devices
Extensive domestic and international distribution network
Dedicated in-house research and development capabilities
Multiple manufacturing facilities across India and Thailand
Diversified revenue streams from sales in over 65 countries
risks: High dependency on revenues from the Supraflex Cruz stent
Stringent domestic and global regulatory compliance requirements
Vulnerability to foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations
Reliance on limited third-party suppliers for key raw materials
Exposure to pricing controls and healthcare reimbursement caps

ipos.name: Bonfiglioli Transmissions
ipos.about: Bonfiglioli Transmissions manufactures gearboxes, gear motors, and drive systems for original equipment manufacturers operating across the industry and automation, off-highway mobility, and wind industries. The company produces specific products such as yaw and pitch drives for the wind sector and low- to medium-duty gear motors for industry and automation customers. It operates three separate manufacturing facilities located in Thirumudivakkam, Mannur, and Talegaon to support its production needs. A major portion of its revenue is generated by co-engineering custom products directly with its customers. Furthermore, the business operates under a license agreement with its corporate promoter, granting it the right to manufacture and sell products utilizing the promoter’s proprietary technology, designs, and trademarks. The company distributes its products domestically and exports them to international markets including the United States, Italy, Germany, and China.
strengths: Diverse gearbox and drive systems portfolio across multiple sectors.
Strong global export footprint across the US, Europe, and China.
Deep customer integration via co-engineered products.
Three established manufacturing facilities in India.
Strong backing and IP access from Bonfiglioli S.p.A.
risks: High dependency on a limited number of suppliers for materials.
Vulnerable to operational disruptions at manufacturing facilities.
Heavily reliant on the corporate promoter for IP and technology.
Revenue is concentrated among a few key OEM customers.
Long co-engineering cycles risk commercial failure or delays.

ipos.name: Shellz India
ipos.about: Shellz India is a manufacturer of confectionery products operating primarily in the mass-market segment with price points below ₹10. The company caters to price-sensitive consumers across Tier II and Tier III cities, maintaining a significant geographic focus on the North Indian market, which contributes the majority of its sales. Its core product portfolio comprises baked treats, choco delights, jellies, panned and sugar candies, alongside food and bakery ingredients. The business generates revenue mainly through the sale of these products under its primary brands, Hugs and Tosca. To reach consumers, the company relies on a distribution network of super stockists who supply local distributors, wholesalers, and retail outlets. Shellz India conducts manufacturing operations from its Delhi facility, while working to consolidate production capacity at a new facility in Sonipat, Haryana. Furthermore, it has undertaken backward integration by producing packaging materials in-house for captive consumption.
strengths: Diverse confectionery product portfolio.
Extensive North Indian distribution network.
Efficient in-house packaging capabilities.
Strong mass-market segment presence.
Significant capacity with expansion plans.
risks: Heavy reliance on North Indian markets.
Intense mass-market pricing competition.
Vulnerability to raw material cost volatility.
Lack of long-term customer/supplier contracts.
Regulatory compliance and licensing risks.
objectsOfIssue: Repayment or prepayment of certain outstanding borrowings (22 (36.68%))

ipos.name: Fusion CX
ipos.about: Fusion CX is an information technology-enabled customer experience solutions and business process outsourcing provider delivering multi-channel engagement, technical support, back-office processing, and digital customer care services to clients across global markets. The company operates through an international network of delivery centers, providing multi-language support across key operational verticals including telecommunications, utilities, high technology, travel, financial services, retail, and healthcare. Fusion CX generates revenue primarily through fees charged for customer experience management, process automation, and technology-driven operations structured under service contracts with enterprise clients. The company integrates proprietary software applications, artificial intelligence platforms, and a global workforce to deliver integrated omnichannel customer interaction and workflow execution solutions. Fusion CX focuses on serving large international corporations with a significant operational presence in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions.
strengths: Global delivery setup supporting multi-language customer operations.
Diversified customer base across key industry verticals.
Long-term relationships with key enterprise clients.
Proprietary artificial intelligence tools integrated into operations.
In-house growth driven by strategic global acquisitions.
risks: Heavy reliance on top 10 customers for revenue.
Significant revenue concentration in North American markets.
Vulnerability to cybersecurity breaches and data privacy laws.
High employee costs and talent retention challenges.
Exposure to foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
objectsOfIssue: Prepayment or repayment for company and subsidiaries (275.70 (55.14%))
Upgrading IT tools for Arya and MindVoice (61.15 (12.23%))

ipos.name: Ravita Engineering Services
ipos.about: Ravita Engineering Services provides engineering solutions for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems, temperature control systems, and other allied electro-mechanical equipment. The company operates across three primary business segments: offshore projects, onshore projects, and the data center industry. Its core business activities are divided into Engineering, Procurement, Installation, and Commissioning (EPIC) projects, as well as standalone Operations and Maintenance (O&M) service contracts. In certain instances, the company executes hybrid projects that combine initial EPIC work with subsequent long-term O&M services. The company procures critical hardware components and server infrastructure from third-party original equipment manufacturers to develop and deploy its solutions. Operations are primarily concentrated in western India, with significant project execution occurring in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and the territorial waters of India. Revenue is generated through competitive bidding and tender processes for both public sector undertakings and private corporate clients.
strengths: Diverse HVAC portfolio across offshore, onshore, and data centers.
Strategic geographic presence in western India and offshore regions.
Robust order book and consistent history of profitability.
Strong client relationships driving repeat EPIC contracts.
Specialized expertise in hybrid engineering and O&M projects.
risks: High revenue concentration from top clients poses financial risks.
The geographic concentration in Western India exposes operations to local disruptions.
Dependence on competitive bidding creates revenue uncertainty.
Reliance on contract labor and OEMs risks cost overruns and delays.
Promoter-linked entity strike-off poses regulatory and reputational risks.
objectsOfIssue: To meet long-term working capital requirements (70 (60.32%))
Capital expenditure for purchase of heavy equipment (25.53 (22%))

ipos.name: HD Fire Protect
ipos.about: HD Fire Protect is a manufacturer and supplier of comprehensive fire protection equipment and systems, catering to diverse sectors such as industrial, commercial, residential, and infrastructure across India and over 90 countries. The company’s core business involves designing and producing a wide range of products, including water spray nozzles, foam equipment and suppression systems, gas suppression systems, deluge valves, pre-action systems, and custom-engineered solutions. It generates revenue primarily through the sale of these manufactured goods, alongside offering contract manufacturing services for off-the-shelf standard products. The business operates through a multi-tiered sales network comprising direct customers and international distributors, relying on short-term purchase orders. Production is centralized across two manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra. A significant portion of its sales stems from export markets, demonstrating a strong global footprint. The company maintains stringent quality controls, adhering to safety certifications.
strengths: Second-largest Indian fire protection equipment maker in FY25.
Comprehensive water, foam, and gas suppression portfolio.
Global presence with exports to over 90 countries.
Major safety certifications including UL, FM, and CE.
In-house R&D and dedicated fire-testing facilities.
risks: Product failures can trigger liabilities and brand damage.
Concentrated manufacturing footprint limited to Maharashtra.
No long-term supply agreements for raw materials.
Revenue volatility from lack of long-term customer contracts.
High dependence on keeping international safety certifications active.

ipos.name: Vaibhav Vyapaar
ipos.about: Vaibhav Vyapaar is a non-banking financial company registered with the Reserve Bank of India that primarily provides unsecured personal loans to salaried and self-employed individuals. The company operates a fully digital lending platform, extending credit both on a direct lending and co-lending basis. In addition to its core lending operations, the company generates revenue by offering its proprietary application and technology services to other non-banking financial companies. The business operates through a technology-driven model that facilitates credit access using a paperless, scalable, and customer-centric process. Through its digital lending application, LoanFront, the company offers a range of financial services, including instant personal loans and specialized salaried loans. By focusing on technology integration and digital onboarding, the company streamlines the entire loan lifecycle from customer acquisition and credit assessment to loan disbursement and collections across its target retail borrower segments.
strengths: Deep ground-level market understanding and retail customer insights.
Fully digital lending platform supported by proprietary in-house technology.
Highly experienced leadership and professional management team.
Robust automated underwriting framework and risk management systems.
Seamless paperless customer onboarding and credit assessment process.
risks: Business profitability is highly exposed to interest rate volatility.
Significant AUM concentration in specific Indian states and regions.
High credit risk profile associated with unsecured personal loan borrowers.
Heavy reliance on third-party software vendors for critical digital operations.
Operations are vulnerable to disruptions in digital payment systems.
objectsOfIssue: Augment the capital base of the company (32 (78.93%))

ipos.name: R.K.Fashion Accessories
ipos.about: R.K. Fashion Accessories operates as a Kolkata-based manufacturer and wholesale distributor of fashion jewellery, alongside trading in branded cosmetics. The company produces handcrafted jewellery that blends traditional designs with contemporary styles, utilizing a network of third-party contract manufacturers for its production processes. Its core business centers on distributing these products across multiple channels, including business-to-business wholesale networks, direct-to-consumer retail stores, e-commerce platforms, and a Shop-in-Shop retail model. Revenue is predominantly generated through its wholesale distribution segment, which accounts for the vast majority of its sales. The company maintains a highly concentrated market presence in eastern India, particularly in West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, and Jharkhand. By strategically combining outsourced manufacturing with a diversified sales and distribution framework, the company caters to varied market segments within the fashion and personal care sectors.
strengths: Multi-channel distribution network across B2B, B2C, e-commerce, and retail.
Diverse portfolio spanning handcrafted fashion jewellery and branded cosmetics.
Expanding scale through upcoming company-owned B2B and B2C showrooms.
Investing in an in-house plating facility to enhance manufacturing control.
Strong regional footprint with over 86% of revenue from eastern India.
risks: 100% reliant on third-party contract manufacturers.
Revenue is highly concentrated in Eastern India.
Changing fashion trends risk inventory obsolescence.
High inventory and extended receivables strain capital.
Lacks definitive agreements for proposed new showrooms.
objectsOfIssue: Funding to meet working capital requirements (5.21 (14.89%))
Establish new plating facility in Baruipur, Kolkata (8.8 (25.15%))
Establish proposed new B2B showroom in Kolkata (5.37 (15.35%))
Complete interiors and furnishings of B2C stores in Kolkata (2.48 (7.09%))
Fund inventory costs for proposed new showroom and stores (5.6 (16%))

ipos.name: Paramount Syntex
ipos.about: Paramount Syntex is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of synthetic fibers, yarns, and knitted cloth, catering to the textile industry. The company generates revenue by selling its products in domestic markets, primarily within Punjab, as well as through export sales. Its key product offerings include acrylic wool yarns, polyester yarns, nylon yarns, blended fancy yarns, and recycled acrylic fibers. Operating from its manufacturing facilities located in Ludhiana, Punjab, the company conducts in-house fiber processing, tow dyeing, hank dyeing, spinning, bulking, twisting, and packing. A notable aspect of its business model involves recycling domestic and imported waste acrylic fibers to convert them into value-added yarns. The company serves diverse end user sectors, including apparel, home textiles, hosiery, fashion knitting, and industrial textiles. Its integrated manufacturing facility enables operational efficiency and complete control over product quality and processing workflows.
strengths: Fully integrated in-house manufacturing setup.
Eco-friendly recycling of waste acrylic into premium yarns.
High capacity utilization averaging 70% to 83%.
Strict end-to-end control over quality and delivery.
Ample existing infrastructure for seamless expansion.
risks: Orders for 100% of proposed machinery remain unplaced.
Project funding requirements are unappraised by any bank.
Unhedged forex exposure risks machinery cost overruns.
Machinery procurement delays could disrupt implementation.
Heavy reliance on a single manufacturing facility in Punjab.
objectsOfIssue: Funding of capital expenditure for machinery at existing facilities (61.68(75.41%))

ipos.name: TNA Solutions
ipos.about: TNA Solutions manufactures and supplies home textile products to domestic and international markets. The company operates primarily on a business-to-business model, manufacturing customized home furnishings according to client specifications for domestic and overseas brands. Its product portfolio includes sheeting products such as flat sheets, fitted sheets, and duvet sets, as well as pillow pairs, towels, and top-of-bed items like comforters, mattress protectors, and quilts. The company also operates a direct-to-consumer segment under its brand, Ambra Linens. TNA Solutions generates revenue from the sale of these home textile goods across India and export markets including the United States, United Arab Emirates, South Africa, and the United Kingdom. Operations are conducted through its manufacturing facility situated in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, which undertakes cutting, stitching, embroidery, finishing, quality inspection, and packaging, while outsourcing fabric dyeing, printing, and other wet processing to external job workers.
strengths: Diverse home textile product portfolio serving both B2B and B2C segments.
Established international presence with exports to over ten countries.
Expanding manufacturing capacity to effectively meet rising customer demand.
Successful launch of proprietary direct-to-consumer brand, Ambra Linens.
Consistent revenue growth driven by strong relationships with key clients.
risks: Significant revenue concentration in the sheeting product segment.
Heavy reliance on a limited number of B2B customers for the majority of sales.
High working capital requirements have led to negative operating cash flows.
Business operations depend heavily on a single manufacturing facility in Indore.
Reliance on third-party job workers for essential fabric processing activities.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for new manufacturing unit and machinery (6.76(17.86%))

ipos.name: Acme India Industries
ipos.about: Acme India Industries operates in the Indian railway rolling stock sector, specializing in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of railway coach interiors. The company provides turnkey furnishing solutions for new railway coaches, refurbishment and conversion of existing coaches, and comprehensive lavatory upgrades. Its core business activities encompass designing and producing interior components such as wall panels, ceilings, toilet modules, wash basins, and mirror frames utilizing fibre-reinforced plastic and aluminum polymer composites. Revenue is primarily generated through turnkey contracts awarded on a competitive bidding basis by the Ministry of Railways, Indian Railways, and related public sector undertakings. Operating through multiple manufacturing units in Haryana, the company maintains internal capabilities to fabricate precision coach components and manage project execution across India. Focusing exclusively on passenger rail infrastructure, the company delivers integrated interior solutions tailored to meet functional, hygiene, and safety requirements specified by railway authorities.
strengths: In-house manufacturing reduces reliance on third-party vendors.
Proven execution of turnkey contracts for Indian Railways.
Broad portfolio of interior panels and toilet modules.
Strategic global tie-ups for advanced railway technology.
Capacity expansion via planned machinery procurement.
risks: High working capital requirements strain liquidity.
Revenue fully dependent on Indian Railways spending.
Outstanding legal and tax proceedings against the company.
Potential delays in executing planned capital expenditure.
Strict quality inspections with risk of order cancellations.
objectsOfIssue: Funding to meet working capital requirements (38(35.86%))
Funding Capital Expenditure for plant & machinery (6.27(5.92%))

ipos.name: Shree TNB Polymers
ipos.about: Shree TNB Polymers operates in the polymer manufacturing sector, producing a range of plastic products across its three primary divisions: the Piping Division, the Solid Industrial Sheets Division, and the Corrugated/Flute Board Sheets Division. The company’s core business involves manufacturing and distributing these items under distinct brand names, specifically Noble, Tirupati, and Balaji (Wellpack). Its manufacturing operations are centralized in two facilities located in Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli. The company generates revenue through the sale of its manufactured products to various customer segments, including business houses, other manufacturing facilities, government entities, and end consumers. These sales are facilitated through direct channels as well as an established network of over 325 dealers and distributors across multiple states. Its product offerings cater to diverse industrial and consumer needs, relying on raw materials to maintain its manufacturing output.
strengths: Diverse product portfolio across piping, corrugated, and solid industrial sheets.
Established network of over 325 dealers across key commercial hubs.
Strategically located manufacturing facilities near major industrial areas.
Proven track record of consistent revenue generation across multiple brand divisions.
Expanding market footprint across diverse regional markets and states.
risks: High dependence on top ten customers for significant portions of revenue.
Business operations rely on leased manufacturing facilities and warehouses.
Potential under-utilization of newly expanded manufacturing capacities.
Volatility in the supply and pricing of raw materials impacting profit margins.
Subject to strict regional regulations and potential penalties for delayed compliance.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for purchase of machinery (15.86 (50.83%))
Capital expenditure for solar panel/roof top (2.6 (8.33%))

ipos.name: EverestIMS Technologies
ipos.about: EverestIMS Technologies is an information technology company providing software products and services focused on IT operations and service management. The company delivers solutions across IT service management, IT infrastructure management, network configuration and content management, artificial intelligence for IT operations, IT asset management, and operations support systems. EverestIMS Technologies offers its customers multiple consumption models, providing both software as a service (SaaS) and on-premises software solutions to meet varying operational requirements. Its business involves integrating third-party open-source databases, operating systems, queuing engines, and development tools into customer deliverables. The company derives its revenue primarily from the sale of software products, software services, and hardware products to its client base, which includes large corporate customers. Additionally, the company serves clients overseas in countries such as the United Arab Emirates and Malaysia, alongside its domestic operations.
strengths: Offers multiple SaaS and on-premises software models.
Serves diverse overseas clients in the UAE and Malaysia.
Holds long-standing relationships with key corporate customers.
Adopts advanced technologies via a dedicated AI Laboratory.
Shows strong and consistent financial and revenue growth
risks: High revenue dependence on the top 10 corporate customers.
Absence of formal agreements with some channel partners.
Past negative cash flows from investing and financing.
Software defects may cause liability and customer loss.
Open-source integration exposes the company to IP infringement claims.
objectsOfIssue: Purchase of IT hardware for AI Innovation Lab (5.66 (14.49%))

ipos.name: Nityas Gems and Jewellery
ipos.about: Nityas Gems and Jewellery designs, manufactures, and sells lab-grown diamond-studded gold jewellery in India. The company operates through an integrated business model comprising business-to-business manufacturing and direct-to-consumer retail. Under its business-to-business vertical, it supplies customized and standardized jewellery to organized retail chains, standalone retailers, and wholesalers across multiple Indian states and select overseas markets. Its direct-to-consumer operations are conducted under the brand Ayaani through a subsidiary, featuring an online storefront alongside physical retail stores operated via company-owned and franchise models. The product portfolio includes rings, earrings, pendants, bracelets, mangalsutras, nose pins, necklaces, cufflinks, and bangles, with a strategic focus on lightweight, affordable luxury, and daily-wear jewellery segments. Manufacturing operations are conducted at a single facility in Surat, Gujarat, with an installed production capacity of 360 kilograms per annum, utilizing in-house karigars and computer-aided design capabilities for end-to-end jewellery fabrication.
strengths: Integrated business model spanning B2B manufacturing and D2C omnichannel retail.
Rapidly expanding customer network servicing 323 B2B clients across 18 states.
Design-led manufacturing facility in Surat supported by 122 in-house karigars.
Strong focus on high-growth, affordable lightweight lab-grown diamond jewellery.
Scalable financial performance with operating revenues compounding over 94% annually.
risks: High customer concentration with top 10 clients driving 55.49% of FY26 revenues.
Geographic concentration with five key states contributing over 85% of total sales.
Operations are working capital intensive, requiring significant ongoing funding.
Heavy reliance on top 10 suppliers who accounted for 86.16% of FY26 purchases.
All manufacturing operations are concentrated at a single facility in Surat.

ipos.name: Vishal Nirmiti
ipos.about: Vishal Nirmiti is a civil engineering, construction, and manufacturing firm operating in 2 segments. Its manufacturing arm produces pre-stressed concrete sleepers, pre-cast barriers, and steel/penstock pipes for Indian Railways and private developers. Its services arm delivers EPC solutions for railway, irrigation, and road infrastructure. The company supports regional projects through specialized manufacturing facilities across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, and Himachal Pradesh.
strengths: Diversified across railway sleepers, steel pipes, and EPC works.
Advanced in-house pipe welding and coating manufacturing plants.
Over 95% of operational revenue generated from repeat clients.
Multi-state manufacturing footprint spanning four Indian states.
Experienced promoter group with deep infrastructure expertise.
risks: High revenue dependence on Indian Railways and state tenders.
Top 5 clients account for over 85% of total operating revenue.
Substantial working capital needs funded by short-term loans.
Business relies on purchase orders without long-term contracts.
Indebtedness exposes the business to debt servicing and covenants.
objectsOfIssue: Repayment and/or pre-payment of certain borrowings (19 (13.10%))

ipos.name: Omara Ventures India
ipos.about: Omara Ventures India is a retail jeweller specializing in the curation and sale of designer diamond jewellery. The company offers a diverse product portfolio that includes bridal, festive, special occasion, and contemporary daily-wear jewellery, alongside gold jewellery and silver coins. Its core operations revolve around a design-led retail model operated through its boutique, where it provides customers with a personalized experience featuring customized jewellery discussions and private consultations. Omara Ventures generates revenue primarily through the direct retail sale of high-value solitaire and diamond pieces, which historically account for the vast majority of its product sales. By focusing on customization tailored to specific customer needs and maintaining well-established relationships with skilled artisans, the company successfully serves the premium market segment. Operating primarily out of the Chandigarh region, it emphasizes curated designs and a commitment to hallmarked assurance for retail investors.
strengths: Experienced promoters and a dedicated management team guiding operations.
Diversified product portfolio featuring curated diamond and gold jewellery.
Strong focus on customization based on individual customer needs.
Well-established relationships with skilled jewellery artisans and suppliers.
Deep commitment to product quality and hallmarked jewellery assurance.
risks: High dependence on suppliers for raw materials.
Revenue heavily concentrated in Solitaire and Diamond jewellery.
Geographically concentrated with operations primarily in Chandigarh.
High inventory levels significantly increase working capital needs.
Past delays and non-compliance in statutory and tax filings.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for Renovation and Expansion of the Jewellery Boutique (2 (4.76%))
Repayment and/or pre-payment of certain borrowings (18 (42.87%))

ipos.name: Dove Soft
ipos.about: Dove Soft is an integrated cloud-communications solutions provider offering multi-channel communication services to businesses. The company provides enterprise clients and over-the-top platforms with transactional Short Message Service, Rich Communication Services, WhatsApp, Voice, Interactive Voice Response, automated voice call solutions, Email, and digital marketing products. It operates on a usage-based pay-per-use revenue model, generating income based on the volume of messages and voice pulses processed through its platform. The business caters to clients across diverse industry sectors, including telecom, information technology, banking, financial services, insurance, e-commerce, retail, healthcare, real estate, automobile, travel, and food and beverages. The company engages with mobile network operators on an invoice-based arrangement and collaborates with channel partners and messaging infrastructure providers to deliver its services. Its cloud platform enables organizations to manage customer interactions, streamline business operations, and enhance messaging reach efficiently across multiple digital communication channels.
strengths: Multi-channel cloud communications provider with a scalable platform.
Diversified client base across telecom, BFSI, retail, and e-commerce sectors.
Recurring usage-based revenue model delivering consistent revenue growth.
Strategic relationships with mobile network operators and channel partners.
Experienced promoter and key management team with domain expertise.
risks: High customer concentration with top 10 clients contributing most revenue.
Substantial working capital requirements due to extended customer credit terms.
Dependency on direct telecom operators and third-party infrastructure providers.
Regional revenue concentration primarily in Northern and Western India.
Past instances of negative cash flows from operating activities.

ipos.name: Sollfege Smart Electronics
ipos.about: Sollfege Smart Electronics operates as a distributor and retailer of premium electronic products, trading across three core business segments: audio solutions, video solutions, and smart living solutions. The company generates the majority of its revenue from trading activities by sourcing high-end consumer electronics from third-party global and domestic suppliers and selling them through retail showrooms and experience centres. Its audio portfolio includes high-end speakers, home theatre systems, soundbars, and wireless speakers. The video segment offers premium projectors, televisions, and video wall systems. The smart living segment encompasses home automation systems, lifestyle and wellness equipment, as well as networking, security, and surveillance products such as smart locks, video door phones, and closed-circuit television systems. Additionally, the business provides customer support and ancillary services related to product installation and system integration. The company caters to both retail consumers and commercial clients seeking premium tech offerings.
strengths: Comprehensive product portfolio across audio, video, and smart living solutions.
Established presence with experiential retail showrooms in strategic markets.
Strong relationships with prominent global and domestic electronic brands.
Customer-centric business model featuring live product demonstrations.
Experienced promoter and key management team with deep industry knowledge.
risks: Over 90% of revenue is heavily concentrated in West Bengal.
Entirely dependent on third-party suppliers for all products.
High revenue reliance on top five brands and key customers.
History of delayed statutory and regulatory compliance filings.
Working capital-intensive business vulnerable to inventory risks.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for launching 12 new retail showrooms (8.54 (39.21%))

ipos.name: Eventions
ipos.about: Eventions operates as an integrated event management company specializing in providing Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions (MICE) solutions, corporate events, and brand activations for various institutions. The company’s core business involves the conceptualization, planning, coordination, and on-ground execution of large-format assignments across diverse domestic and international locations. It generates the vast majority of its revenue directly from the MICE segment, primarily serving domestic corporate clients on a project-to-project basis. Additionally, through its subsidiary Gantu Online Private Limited, the company is actively expanding into the business-to-consumer travel sector by offering customized Free Independent Traveller (FIT) services and curated leisure travel itineraries. To execute its projects efficiently, Eventions utilizes an asset-light operating model, relying heavily on a vetted network of third-party vendors, subcontractors, and freelance professionals for stage fabrication, logistics, and production infrastructure rather than maintaining heavy in-house physical assets.
strengths: Proven track record in execution of corporate events and conferences.
Experienced promoters with deep event management industry expertise.
Asset-light and highly scalable business operating model.
Capability to conceptualize and execute large-format corporate events.
Client-centric approach resulting in significant repeat business relationships.
risks: High dependence on a limited number of clients for repeat engagements.
Significant reliance on the MICE segment for a substantial portion of revenue.
Extensive dependence on third-party vendors for event execution.
Vulnerable to macroeconomic shifts impacting corporate event budgets.
Operations face logistical and regulatory challenges across multiple locations.
objectsOfIssue: Repayment and/or pre-payment of certain borrowings (7 (18.36%))

ipos.name: SJP Ultrasonics
ipos.about: SJP Ultrasonics primarily operates in the industrial automation solution segment, providing solutions under three business segments: Plastic Joining Solutions, Industrial Automation, and Laser Technology Solutions. The company is a start-to-finish plastic welding solution provider offering diverse and comprehensive service offerings, including specialized plastic products across varied industry segments. It customises industrial automation solutions for an array of industries such as automotive, pharmaceuticals, electronics, energy, food and beverage, packaging, material handling, water treatment, and textiles. SJP Ultrasonics designs and manufactures special-purpose machines that involve detailed fabrication processes and engineering precision on a made-to-order basis. The company integrates technologies like programmable logic controllers, supervisory control and data acquisition, human-machine interfaces, and robotics into its automation systems. SJP Ultrasonics conducts its entire manufacturing operations from its facility in Vasai, Maharashtra, generating revenue directly from customers, particularly original equipment manufacturers, through milestone-based billing without long-term contracts.
strengths: Comprehensive end-to-end plastic welding solution provider.
Strong, long-standing customer and supplier relationships.
Specialized expertise in custom, made-to-order manufacturing.
Established in-house production facilities in Maharashtra.
Experienced leadership and management team.
risks: High revenue dependence on two primary business segments.
Significant revenue concentration from a few large clients.
Raw material price volatility due to lack of long-term supplier contracts.
Working capital-intensive operations tied to trade receivables management.

objectsOfIssue: Funding capital expenditure towards the purchase of machineries (13.22 (56.37%))

ipos.name: Green Asia Impex
ipos.about: Green Asia Impex operates as an integrated processor and exporter of frozen seafood and agricultural commodities, catering primarily to business-to-business customers, including importers, distributors, and food processing companies in domestic and international markets. The company operates in two main business segments: shrimps and dried chillies. In the shrimp segment, the company sources raw shrimps from local aquaculture farmers and traders, processes them through grading, peeling, deveining, and freezing, and supplies processed frozen shrimp products. In the dried chillies segment, the company procures chillies from agricultural market committee traders and carries out processing activities such as cleaning, grading, and sorting before distribution. Revenue is generated through direct domestic sales within India as well as exports to overseas markets including China, Kuwait, the United States, Malaysia, and the United Kingdom. The company utilizes processing facilities situated in Andhra Pradesh to manage its production operations across both product categories.
strengths: Integrated processor and exporter of frozen seafood and agricultural commodities.
Established customer relationships and presence in key international markets.
Strategically located processing facilities in Andhra Pradesh with a strong sourcing network.
Consistent financial growth with improving operating margins over recent fiscal years.
Experienced promoter group and management team with deep domain expertise.
risks: Significant revenue concentration from export sales to customers located in China.
Dependence on a limited number of large customers for a major portion of revenues.
Operations rely heavily on external borrowings to meet working capital requirements.
Absence of long-term supply contracts for raw material procurement of shrimp and chillies.
Exposure to biosecurity risks, disease outbreaks, and strict international quality standards.

ipos.name: Black Opal Consultants
ipos.about: Black Opal Consultants operates as a financial and real estate consultancy firm providing integrated real estate solutions. The company generates revenue primarily through brokerage income from selling residential and commercial properties under exclusive sales mandates with real estate developers. Additionally, it earns revenue from loan syndication fees, advisory services, and real estate project development activities. Its core business activities include acting as a channel partner for property sales, offering real estate advisory, and facilitating property financing. The company’s operations are geographically concentrated in Uttar Pradesh and Haryana, specifically in Noida, Greater Noida, and Gurugram. It is also diversifying into real estate development, including a commercial hotel project named Veda in Ayodhya through its subsidiary entity, Aurika Developers. Furthermore, the company engages in inventory underwriting for real estate developers and is developing a digital property platform called JustHomz through its wholly owned subsidiary, Black Opal Technologies.
strengths: Integrated advisory, sales, and loan syndication services.
Established channel network in the Delhi-NCR market.
Strategic expansion into Ayodhya commercial real estate.
Tech-driven approach via the JustHomz digital platform.
Highly experienced promoters and management team.
risks: High revenue reliance on a few clients lacking long-term contracts.
Operations highly concentrated in Uttar Pradesh and Haryana.
Entering real estate development without a prior track record.

ipos.name: Papadmalji Agro Foods
ipos.about: Papadmalji Agro Foods engages in the manufacturing of handmade papads, machine-made papads, rice papads, vrat special papads, and moongodi, along with the trading of cereal pellets. The company also carries out white-label manufacturing of handmade papads, producing goods that clients market under their respective brand names and tailored packaging. Revenue is primarily generated through product sales under its key core brands, including Vishal, Zhakaas, and Rozana, alongside direct-to-consumer sales under the Papadmalji brand. Products are distributed across multiple sales channels, such as general trade, modern trade, quick commerce, direct-to-consumer platforms, and sales to merchant exporters for selected Middle Eastern markets. Operations are based out of manufacturing units and facilities situated in Bikaner, Rajasthan. For handmade papad production, the business utilizes a decentralized operational system involving contractors and home-based women workers who perform hand rolling according to prescribed quality specifications before final inspection.
strengths: Established brand presence via Vishal, Zhakaas, and Rozana.
Multi-channel distribution across general and modern trade.
Scalable in-house and decentralized manufacturing model.
Diverse portfolio of papads, moongodi, and cereal pellets.
Promoters possess extensive food processing industry experience.
risks: Revenue is heavily concentrated in the papad product segment.
Significant dependency on a limited number of top customers.
Operations and core sales are geographically concentrated in Rajasthan.
Lacks long-term supply agreements for agricultural raw materials.
Core brands face pending logo registrations and trademark oppositions.
objectsOfIssue: Capital expenditure for setting up a new manufacturing facility at Bikaner (7.9 (42.66%))
